area.sourceLabel: GBM On Demand page and zone shapefiles (agency-supplied)
area.bookingInfo: Book in the GBM On Demand app or call 920-448-3185 (option 2).
area.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in the zones open at that hour. If a bus is the quicker way, the app offers the bus instead.

Daytime Zone.serviceHours: Monday–Friday 5:15 AM–11:30 PM and Saturday 7:45 AM–7:45 PM.

All Zone.serviceHours: Evenings and Saturday afternoons, after the buses stop: Monday–Friday 6:45–11:30 PM and Saturday 1:45–7:45 PM.

notes: Zones from the shapefiles Mason Shea (Brown County Planning / Green Bay MPO) sent Atlas Outreach on 2026-11-18 (CIV-1982), 'Ryan Hanna GBM On Demand Service Area.zip' (saved unchanged in _reports/agency-files/green-bay/): 'GBM On Demand Daytime Zones' (7 shapes, the blue zones) and 'GBM On Demand All Zones' (4 shapes, the green zone), in WISCRS Brown County (US feet), reprojected to WGS84 at 7 decimal places (about 1 cm), dropping points that rounding made repeat. Geometry used as given; one All Zone shape is a 3,600 sq ft speck on its own, kept as sent. How the zones work, from Mason: the Daytime zones run during fixed-route hours; once the buses stop, the All Zone opens until 11:30 PM on weekdays and the Daytime zones stay open too; during fixed-route hours trips within the All Zone are sent to the bus. Hours from greenbaywi.gov/GBM-On-Demand (Daytime Monday–Friday 5:15 AM–6:45 PM and Saturday 7:45 AM–1:45 PM; any zone Monday–Friday 6:45–11:30 PM and Saturday 1:45–7:45 PM). No Sunday service is stated. Fare is the regular bus fare; open to anyone.
